data.name: Sensitivity Result
data.expression:
VAR _selectedDates = CALCULATETABLE(VALUES('Date'[Date]), ALLSELECTED('Date'))
VAR _ends = VALUES('Review Window'[Window End])
VAR _minimum = IF(NOT ISFILTERED('Review Minimum'), 100, IF(HASONEVALUE('Review Minimum'[Minimum]), SELECTEDVALUE('Review Minimum'[Minimum]), BLANK()))
VAR _companies = VALUES('Company'[Company Key])
VAR _products = VALUES('Product'[Product Key])
VAR _issues = VALUES('Issue'[Issue Key])
VAR _singlePrune = HASONEVALUE('Review Selection'[Selection Key])
VAR _focusKeyPrune = SELECTEDVALUE('Review Selection'[Selection Key])
VAR _identities = SELECTCOLUMNS(CALCULATETABLE('Review Selection', REMOVEFILTERS('Review Selection'), TREATAS({_focusKeyPrune}, 'Review Selection'[Selection Key])),
    "__key", 'Review Selection'[Selection Key], "__segment", 'Review Selection'[Segment Key],
    "__company", 'Review Selection'[Company Key], "__product", 'Review Selection'[Product Key],
    "__issue", 'Review Selection'[Issue Key], "__end", 'Review Selection'[Window End])
VAR _candidates = FILTER(_identities, [__end] IN _ends && [__company] IN _companies &&
    [__product] IN _products && [__issue] IN _issues && _singlePrune && [__key] == _focusKeyPrune)
VAR _statistics = GENERATE(_candidates,
    VAR _company = [__company]
    VAR _product = [__product]
    VAR _issue = [__issue]
    VAR _end = [__end]
    VAR _start = EDATE(_end, -2)
    VAR _months = SELECTCOLUMNS(GENERATESERIES(0, 2), "__month", EDATE(_start, [Value]))
    VAR _monthly = GENERATE(_months,
        VAR _month = [__month]
        VAR _next = EDATE(_month, 1)
        VAR _monthDates = FILTER(_selectedDates, 'Date'[Date] >= _month && 'Date'[Date] < _next)
        RETURN ROW("__complete", COUNTROWS(_monthDates) = DAY(EOMONTH(_month, 0)),
            "__fc", CALCULATE([Complaint Count], REMOVEFILTERS('Review Selection'), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), TREATAS(_monthDates, 'Date'[Date]), KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS({_company}, 'Company'[Company Key])), KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS({_product}, 'Product'[Product Key])), KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS({_issue}, 'Issue'[Issue Key]))),
"__fk", CALCULATE([Known Flag Count], REMOVEFILTERS('Review Selection'), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), TREATAS(_monthDates, 'Date'[Date]), KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS({_company}, 'Company'[Company Key])), KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS({_product}, 'Product'[Product Key])), KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS({_issue}, 'Issue'[Issue Key]))),
"__fn", CALCULATE([Untimely No Count], REMOVEFILTERS('Review Selection'), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), TREATAS(_monthDates, 'Date'[Date]), KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS({_company}, 'Company'[Company Key])), KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS({_product}, 'Product'[Product Key])), KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS({_issue}, 'Issue'[Issue Key]))),
"__pc", CALCULATE([Complaint Count], REMOVEFILTERS('Review Selection'), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), TREATAS(_monthDates, 'Date'[Date]), KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS({_company}, 'Company'[Company Key])), KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS({_product}, 'Product'[Product Key])), REMOVEFILTERS('Issue'), 'Issue'[Issue Key] <> _issue),
"__pk", CALCULATE([Known Flag Count], REMOVEFILTERS('Review Selection'), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), TREATAS(_monthDates, 'Date'[Date]), KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS({_company}, 'Company'[Company Key])), KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS({_product}, 'Product'[Product Key])), REMOVEFILTERS('Issue'), 'Issue'[Issue Key] <> _issue),
"__pn", CALCULATE([Untimely No Count], REMOVEFILTERS('Review Selection'), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), TREATAS(_monthDates, 'Date'[Date]), KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS({_company}, 'Company'[Company Key])), KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS({_product}, 'Product'[Product Key])), REMOVEFILTERS('Issue'), 'Issue'[Issue Key] <> _issue)))
    VAR _complete = COUNTROWS(FILTER(_monthly, NOT [__complete])) = 0
    VAR _era = _end < DATE(2023,8,1) || _start >= DATE(2023,9,1)
    VAR _known = MINX(_monthly, [__fk]) > 0 && MINX(_monthly, [__pk]) > 0
    VAR _volume = MINX(_monthly, MIN([__fc], [__pc]))
    VAR _elevated = COUNTROWS(FILTER(_monthly, [__fk] > 0 && [__pk] > 0 &&
        100 * ([__fn] * [__pk] - [__pn] * [__fk]) >= [__fk] * [__pk]))
    RETURN ROW("__complete", _complete, "__era", _era, "__known", _known,
        "__volume", _volume, "__elevated", _elevated,
        "__no", SUMX(_monthly, [__fn]), "__knownCount", SUMX(_monthly, [__fk]),
        "__peerNo", SUMX(_monthly, [__pn]), "__peerKnown", SUMX(_monthly, [__pk]),
        "__complaints", SUMX(_monthly, [__fc])))
VAR _evaluated = ADDCOLUMNS(_statistics,
    "__eligible", [__complete] && [__era] && [__known] && NOT ISBLANK(_minimum) && [__volume] >= _minimum,
    "__stable", [__complete] && [__era] && [__known] && [__volume] >= 200 && [__elevated] >= 2)
VAR _qualified = FILTER(_evaluated, [__eligible] && [__elevated] >= 2)
VAR _focusKey = SELECTEDVALUE('Review Selection'[Selection Key])
VAR _single = HASONEVALUE('Review Selection'[Selection Key])
VAR _row = FILTER(_evaluated, _single && [__key] == _focusKey)
VAR _sensitivity = IF(HASONEVALUE('Sensitivity Minimum'[Minimum]), SELECTEDVALUE('Sensitivity Minimum'[Minimum]), BLANK())
RETURN IF(NOT _single || COUNTROWS(_row) <> 1 || ISBLANK(_sensitivity), "Unavailable",
        IF(MAXX(_row, INT([__complete] && [__era] && [__known] && [__volume] >= _sensitivity && [__elevated] >= 2)) = 1,
        "Qualifies", "Does not qualify"))
